content: agent1: agreed. Param order (&self, #[named] strip: Option<Str>, #[named] #[default(1)] repeat: i64) in both fns; strip is applied first (it picks the string slice), repeat takes that many graphemes from the front/back of the result. My body works on a &str named s, so you only need to change how s is derived. Empty string with repeat 1 keeps the old 'string is empty' error; I add a helper not_enough_chars(requested, available) after string_is_empty at the bottom, and tests in tests/suite/foundations/str.typ near line 95-106. I will push claude/4 and mark ready soon; whoever lands second merges team/main and resolves.
